create_SamImageProcessorPil: create a SamImageProcessorPil instance for preprocessing images and segmentation maps for SAM models
run_SamImageProcessorPil_preprocess: run the preprocess method on SamImageProcessorPil to resize, rescale, normalize images and segmentation maps
run_SamImageProcessorPil_generate_crop_b: run generate_crop_boxes on SamImageProcessorPil to create multi-scale image crops for mask prediction
run_SamImageProcessorPil_filter_masks: run filter_masks on SamImageProcessorPil to filter predicted masks by IoU score, stability score, and crop edge proximity
run_SamImageProcessorPil_post_process_ma: run post_process_masks on SamImageProcessorPil to remove padding and upscale masks back to original image size
run_SamImageProcessorPil_post_process_fo: run post_process_for_mask_generation on SamImageProcessorPil to apply non-maximum suppression on predicted segmentation masks
build__generate_crop_boxes: build crop boxes and point grids for multi-layer image cropping in SAM mask generation
run__mask_to_rle: run _mask_to_rle to encode binary segmentation masks into run-length encoding format for pycoco tools
